questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{方法一：因为}X,Y\text{独立，所以}f(x,y)&=f_x(x)f_y(y).\\P\{X\leq Y\}&=\iint\limits_{x\leq y}f(x,y)dx dy=\iint\limits_{x\leq y}f_x(x)f_y(y)dx dy\\&=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}[f_Y(y)]\int_{-\infty}^{y}f_x(x)dx dy=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}[f_Y(y)F_Y(y)]dy\\&=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}F_Y(y)dF_Y(y)=\frac{F^2(y)}{2}\big|_{-\infty}^{+\infty}=\frac{1}{2},\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\overline{A}=\left\{X\leq a\right\},\ \ \overline{B}=\left\{Y\leq a\right\},\\&P(\overline{A\cup B})=P(\overline{AB})=P(\overline{A})P(\overline{B})=\left[P(\overline{A})\right]^2=\frac{1}{4},\\&\text{从而}P(\overline{A})=\frac{1}{2},\ \text{又}P(\overline{A})=\int_{0}^{x}\frac{3x^2}{8}\,dx=\frac{a^3}{8},\ \text{故}\ \frac{a^3}{8}=\frac{1}{2},\ \text{得}a=\sqrt[3]{4}.\end{aligned}
